workflow.logging_policy: Snapshot-only: keep docs/project-state.json <= 8000 bytes, task summaries <= 320 chars, and <= 6 evidence items (<= 240 chars each). Never append historical daily benchmark logs.

current_capabilities.geometry_and_vector: Analytical curves/arcs, adaptive flattening, intersections, dynamic offset/contour, OSnap inference engine, Pen tracing with Shift-only angle snapping and auto-commit to Node tool, direct segment bending (BendSegment) & multi-node curve conversion, Live Corners with 2x2 property bar, interactive dragging for Round/Scallop/Chamfer with single-step undo batching, Contour floor 0.02 mm; NumericFieldDescriptor maps semantic keys. General filled-path Boolean uses pinned Clipper2 2.0.1 with bounded flattening, checked integer quantization, fill-rule/hole preservation. Layout and Properties page-unit controls route semantic ActionIds; page units drive parser, coordinates, HUD, rulers, fields, tooltips, Snap Grid, presets and import/recovery size labels.
current_capabilities.document_and_color: Native v17 page/raster/paint ICC; v18 Dimension/Contour + typed Contour CMYK/Spot/alpha/overprint/ICC; reads v2–v17. Contour storage/D2D pixel tests pass. Assign/Convert+Undo cover paint/page/document/selection; SVG/TIFF/JPEG RGB ICC. WIC transform conditional; bound-paint preview passes CPU/D2D.
current_capabilities.rendering: Windows ViewportRenderer uses Direct2D 1.1 / D3D11 hardware or WARP; full-frame staging/readback writes BGRA directly for GDI. Target/staging bitmaps reused by size; object-local geometry survives pan/zoom, image uploads use 1024-entry/256 MiB LRU. ICC preview and white page rendering connected. AABB BVH culls by page/revision; DamageTracker limits GDI dirty copies. SoftwareRasterizer supports BGRA as CPU fallback/oracle.
current_capabilities.desktop_shell: Win32 Native Shell shares DIP paint/hit geometry and updates on DPI changes. Typography & Text subsystem: granular delta mutations eliminate property overwrite regressions (family, size, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, justify alignment); Shift+F3 Vietnamese Unicode NFC/NFD case cycling; linked text frames (overflow threading through frame_height_mm); Combine Text (Ctrl+Shift+C) and Split Lines (Ctrl+Shift+S); Text on Path (Ctrl+F8 Bézier fitting, reverse, straighten, Ctrl+Q curves conversion). PowerClip geometric editing supports nested scopes, lock/fit/extract/release and CPU/D2D/WARP views.
current_capabilities.automation_ecosystem: Shared typed AutomationService; MCP Streamable HTTP hosted in desktop process. NativeWindow E2E verifies AC01 600x300 mm Vietnamese layout/font/margins/colors/icons, stable IDs, edit/undo after reopen, 5x2m design, Settings revoke/stale-endpoint. AC02 RPC verifies atomic undo/redo IDs; AC07 RPC verifies 1,000-object paging. AC03 stale-write and active text-draft rejection preserve local edits; AC09 dirty-tab preservation passes. COM registered STA/MTA smoke passes. Stdio MCP sidecar and Windows COM IDispatch local server.
current_capabilities.external_vector_import: Corpus 4 CDR/3 PDF/AI-PDF/2 EPS imports commit/undo; DXF LINE/LWPOLYLINE/ARC/CIRCLE import preserves editable topology. Raster PNG Release x6 passes (Pillow 6/6, CPU/D2D error 0). RAM waiter 95%, resume, cumulative 5 min. Raster export shares 95%/5 min waiter. BigTIFF Release decoder reads uncompressed RGB(A) strip >4 GiB. ICC SWOP lifecycle and Pillow/LittleCMS assertion pass in Release desktop import corpus; WIC within 1/255 on 3 samples.

known_limitations: Qt 6 and Skia backends are future architectural targets pending unified MinGW/MSVC toolchain ABI; runtime currently standardizes on Win32 Native Shell + Direct2D 1.1 / D3D11 + WARP.

Interactive dragging reuses the cached native canvas and updates a small dirty copy when object bounds change; each changed snapshot is still fully rendered/read back by Direct2D. No GPU partial render, tile cache or direct swap-chain presentation is implemented.
DPI coverage uses synthetic 120/144/192/96 DPI events and native captures; physical monitor switching, reference-device latency and production fidelity remain unverified.
Autosave checkpoints use the UI writer synchronously; startup recovery selection UI is not implemented. Job Object memory/process/UI limits do not by themselves prove filesystem/network containment.

CDR uses pinned libcdr-to-SVG subset; PDF/AI use PDFium mapping and EPS uses eps-path-v1 or isolated Ghostscript conversion. PDF page rotations 0/90/180/270 are mapped; object-level rotated/sheared text, effects/clipping, multiple OCG membership, Corel live effects, ICC fidelity, visual/coordinate oracle, all CDR versions, source round-trip, UI runtime, and production remain unverified. Import pauses at 95% RAM and resumes after headroom returns; structural/wire/time limits remain.

TAC is not auto-limited during color conversion. Backend and Settings preflight cover process CMYK paints only; output-condition linkage, spot/raster separation, true overprint separations, and proof/gamut oracles remain unimplemented.

General path Boolean is a bounded polygon approximation: curve flattening and grid quantization produce an explicit error bound, but near-contact topology and manufacturing acceptance are not proven. General Boundary/Simplify and cooperative cancellation remain unsupported.
